_example: EXAMPLE CONFIG - replace every keyword and bucket with the user's own interests. Keywords are matched case-insensitively as substrings of title/text.
note: classify.py / prune.py: keep an item when title/text hits an include word and no exclude word; if it hits both, exclude wins unless a 'strong' word also hits. topics-classify.py: buckets are scored by keyword hits on the title (body text only when the title hits nothing); ties go to the lower priority number; the order of the buckets list is the report order.
